description: This file defines the ConfigServiceClient class which is used as an AWS SDK client to interact with AWS Config service. It includes method signatures for various operations related to AWS Config, utilizing PHPDoc annotations for method definitions and promises.

classes.name: ConfigServiceClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS Config Service, extends AwsClient, providing methods to interact with AWS Config.

methods.name: associateResourceTypes
methods.description: Associates resource types with AWS Config for monitoring.

methods.name: deleteConfigRule
methods.description: Deletes a specified AWS Config rule.

methods.name: describeConfigRules
methods.description: Describes the specified AWS Config rules.

methods.name: getResourceConfigHistory
methods.description: Returns a list of configurations for a specific resource.

methods.name: listDiscoveredResources
methods.description: Lists discovered resources of a particular type.

methods.name: putConfigRule
methods.description: Adds or updates an AWS Config rule.

methods.name: startConfigRulesEvaluation
methods.description: Starts evaluation of AWS Config rules.
